questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What is “operant conditioning”?
A. A treatment for phobias
B. A learning process using rewards and punishments
C. The study of brain function
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie heißt der von B. F. Skinner geprägte Lernprozess, bei dem freiwilliges Verhalten durch Belohnung und Bestrafung geformt wird?
questions.en: What is the name of the learning process, championed by B. F. Skinner, in which voluntary behaviour is shaped by rewards and punishments?

timeline.labelEn: B. F. Skinner publishes The Behavior of Organisms, the founding work on operant conditioning
timeline.labelDe: B. F. Skinner veröffentlicht „The Behavior of Organisms“, das Grundlagenwerk der operanten Konditionierung

questions.notes: Card's answer B confirmed (learning process modifying voluntary behaviour by reward or punishment).

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How do bald eagles perform their courtship rituals?
A. By offering curated stones
B. By performing aerial cartwheel displays
C. By displaying catches like a small game
Answer: B. This behavior involves the eagles interlocking talons and spinning as they free-fall, releasing just before reaching the ground. Eagles may also lock their talons and fall together during territorial disputes, sometimes misjudging and falling to their deaths.
questions.de: Wie nennt man den Balzflug von Weißkopfseeadlern, bei dem sich ein Paar hoch in der Luft an den Fängen verhakt und sich im freien Fall dreht, bis es kurz vor dem Boden loslässt?
questions.en: What name is given to the courtship flight of bald eagles in which a pair lock talons high in the air and spin as they free-fall, letting go just before reaching the ground?

timeline.labelEn: The bald eagle is adopted as the national emblem of the United States
timeline.labelDe: Der Weißkopfseeadler wird zum nationalen Wappentier der Vereinigten Staaten

questions.notes: Confirmed: courtship flight includes cartwheels — fly high, lock talons, free-fall, separate just before the ground. Timeline: no date of its own; uses the 1782 national-emblem adoption from the same page.
